review:
1429 Uncharted Seas is one of Thunderkick's best-known games, a 5x3 nautical slot styled like an old map, with 25 paylines. Expanding wilds and a free spins bonus are the main features.

Its standout number is the 98.6% RTP, one of the highest published for any video slot. With Low volatility and a 670x cap, it's built for long, steady sessions rather than big hits. A classic.
pros: Excellent 98.60% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
